name: Time Out Market
shortDescription: Cais do Sodré food hall with a row of Lisbon kitchens under one roof.

name: Cervejaria Ramiro
shortDescription: Intendente beer hall known for prawns, clams, and a late queue.

name: Pastelaria Aloma
shortDescription: Campolide pastelaria whose custard tarts keep winning city contests.

name: Zé da Mouraria
shortDescription: Lunch-only Mouraria tasca: daily plates, no reservations, empty by 3pm.

name: Taberna da Rua das Flores
shortDescription: Chiado counter tasca with a chalkboard that changes with the market.

name: Solar dos Presuntos
shortDescription: Avenida classic for mariscos and a dining room that still feels like 1970s Lisbon.

name: Manteigaria
shortDescription: Chiado nata shop where the oven is in the window and the tarts leave hot.
